summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K reporting headline results from the ZEUS phase 3 cardiovascular outcomes trial of ziltivekimab. The trial failed to reduce major adverse cardiovascular events versus placebo (HR 0.99, 95% CI 0.88–1.11) despite expected IL-6 pathway engagement. The company will take a non-cash impairment charge in Q3 2026 but maintains its 2026 operating profit outlook. Two other ziltivekimab trials (HERMES, ARTEMIS) continue with readouts expected in H1 2027. This is a clinical trial update, not a special-situation transaction.
